summary: Added web search tools and graceful fallback for Marketing Intelligence. Issue: WebSearch tool hitting 429 rate limit errors. Fixes applied: 1) Added WebSearch, WebFetch, MCP__web_reader__webReader to allowed_tools in insights_runner.py, 2) Updated system prompt to handle WebSearch failures gracefully - AI will now try WebFetch with common URLs (e.g., company.com) and ask user for specific URLs when search fails. LIMITATION: insights_runner.py creates SDK client manually without MCP server configuration, so MCP tools (like brave-search, tavily) won't work. To enable full MCP support, insights_runner.py would need to be refactored to use create_client() from core/client instead of manually creating ClaudeSDKClient. For now, the AI will gracefully fall back to asking for URLs when WebSearch fails.
current_status: COMPLETE - Graceful fallback implemented, but full MCP support requires architectural change
